name: Azure Cloud Shell Execution
description: Azure Cloud Shell is a browser terminal that already has the signed-in user's cloud permissions. An attacker who is already in the portal can open Cloud Shell to run commands without planting malware on a laptop. This is not how they first get in. It is how they work after they have a session. Cloud Shell creation for a privileged account from an unusual place is interactive takeover, not initial phishing.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
